stem: Which child qualifies for NIP-funded influenza vaccination because of age alone in 2025?
explanation: A healthy 3-year-old child qualifies for NIP-funded influenza vaccination on age alone because the funded age group is 6 months to less than 5 years.

citations.source: Louisa Leone MD3 2025 - Child and Adolescent Health - Study Notes.pdf
citations.title: Louisa Leone MD3 2025 - Child and Adolescent Health - Study Notes.pdf

optionExplanations.A: Incorrect because the funded age group starts at 6 months, so a 4-month-old is too young
optionExplanations.B: Correct because a healthy child aged 3 years falls within the 6 months to less than 5 years funded age group
optionExplanations.C: Incorrect because a healthy child aged 5 years is not funded on age alone once they reach the fifth birthday
optionExplanations.D: Incorrect because a healthy 10-year-old does not qualify for NIP-funded influenza vaccination on age alone
optionExplanations.E: Incorrect because a healthy 15-year-old does not qualify for NIP-funded influenza vaccination on age alone
